title: सांस्कृतिक आलोकमा ‘अविरल बग्दछ इन्द्रावती’ उपन्यासको विवेचना (Analysis of the novel 'Aviral Baghydya Indravati' in the cultural light)
nepali: प्रस्तुत शोधलेख रमेश विकलद्वारा लेखिएको ‘अविरल बग्दछ इन्द्रावती’ उपन्यास (२०४०) मा चित्रित सांस्कृतिक पक्षसँग सम्बद्ध छ । यसमा इन्दावती नदी किनाराका समुदाय र विशेष गरी माझी जातिको सामाजिकस्थान, रहनसहन, भेषभूषा, आम्दानीको स्रोत, अधिकार उपयोग जस्ता विविध पक्षको अध्ययन र विश्लेषण गरी त्यहाँको सांस्कृतिक पक्ष केलाउने प्रयत्न गरिएको छ । संस्कृति परम्परादेखि मानव व्यवहारबाटै निर्मित हुँदै आएको पाइन्छ । संस्कृतिमा परम्परादेखि प्रचलित मूल्य–मान्यताहरूका साथै बदलिँदो परिवेशसँगै सृजित नवीन व्यवहारसमेत थपिँदै जान्छन् । यस लेखमा ‘अविरल बग्दछ इन्द्रावती’ उपन्यासमा प्रस्तुत विषयवस्तुमा आधारित भएर राजनीतिक शक्तिका आडमा उन्मत्त सामन्ती वर्गको क्रूर र आततायी व्यवहार सहँदै आएका निर्धाहरू अन्यायकाविरुद्धमा आवाज उठाउँदै  आफ्नो अधिकार प्राप्त गर्ने हिम्मत देखाएको अवस्थाले सामन्तको अधोगति र निर्धाहरू सङ्गठित  भई सशक्त हुँदै आएको सङ्क्रमणकालीन अवस्थामा देखिने विभिन्न सांस्कृतिक रूपहरूको खोजी गरी समयको गतिसँगैसांस्कृतिक स्वरूप पनि परिवर्तन हुँदै जान्छ भन्ने निष्कर्ष  निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This research paper deals with the cultural aspects illustrated in Ramesh Kandel's novel 'Aviral Baghydya Indravati' (2040). It examines the social position, residence, attire, sources of income, and utilization of rights of the communities, particularly the Majhi caste, along the banks of the Indravati River. Culture is found to be created from human behavior through tradition. Culture, along with established values and beliefs, also includes newly emerging behavior with changing environment. In this paper, based on the text of the novel 'Aviral Baghydya Indravati', the various cultural forms present during the time of transition when the destitute engaged in cruel and oppressive behavior in conspiracy with feudal forces are examined, where determined destitute, living together to obtain their rights by opposing the tyrant, showed the decline of feudalism and began to organize themselves. Through the investigation of culture, tradition and established values and beliefs are examined in this paper, as well as a changing environment that contributes to new behavior. The conclusion of the paper is that culture evolves continuously, as various cultural forms of the transitional period of time to time have been examined, showing that at a particular moment in time, the environment changes, values change, and human behavior also changes with new forms.
british_english: This scholarly paper explores the cultural elements depicted in Ramesh Kandel's novel 'Aviral Baghydya Indravati' (2040). It investigates the social standing, habitation, dress, sources of income, and the use of entitlements of the communities, particularly the Majhi caste, residing along the banks of the Indravati River. Culture is observed to originate from human conduct through tradition. Culture encompasses not only established values and beliefs but also newly emerging conduct alongside a changing environment. In this paper, grounded in the text of the novel 'Aviral Baghydya Indravati', the diverse cultural manifestations present during the transitional period when the destitute engaged in cruel and oppressive behavior in collusion with feudal forces are examined. During this time, determined destitute individuals united to secure their rights by opposing the tyrant, demonstrating the decline of feudalism and beginning to organize themselves. This paper's investigation of culture examines tradition and established values and beliefs, along with a changing environment that fosters new conduct. The paper's conclusion is that culture undergoes continuous evolution, as various cultural forms of the transitional period have been examined, demonstrating that at specific moments in time, the environment shifts, values transform, and human conduct adapts to new forms.
australian_english: This study paper looks into the cultural stuff shown in Ramesh Kandel's novel 'Aviral Baghydya Indravati' (2040). It checks out the social spot, living places, what they wear, how they get their money, and how they use their rights, especially for the Majhi caste people living by the Indravati River. They found that culture comes from how people act, based on tradition. Culture isn't just about old values and beliefs, it's also about new behaviour and how the environment changes. This paper's based on the text of 'Aviral Baghydya Indravati' novel, looking at the different cultural things happening during a time when poor people were getting badly treated by feudal rulers who were working together. Poor people started banding together to fight back and get their rights, showing that feudalism was falling apart and they were organizing themselves. The paper looks at how culture, traditions, values and the environment changes to create new behaviour. It ends by saying that culture keeps changing, as you can see from the different cultural things happening during the changing times - when the environment changes, values change and how people act changes too.
